question: How do equal, label-free quality-aware, and training-tuned constant-weight fusion behave under informative, unrelated, and misleading quality in controlled mathematical classification fixtures?
data_license: repository BSD-3-Clause; generated mathematical fixtures, no participant data
noise_sigma: 0.4 + 2.4 * degradation; degradation independently Uniform(0,1) per record and modality
quality_direction: larger is declared better in all conditions, including the intentionally misleading ablation
eligibility: all generated records; both modalities present; no exclusions or scientific QC gating in this benchmark

comparator_definitions.quality: training-fold robust quality scaling, directed sigmoid reliability, normalized fMRI reliability weight
comparator_definitions.tuned_constant: one global fMRI weight per outer fold selected by lowest training inner-OOF Brier score; tie nearest 0.5 then lower weight

model: median imputer; standard scaler; balanced L2 logistic regression, liblinear, max_iter=5000
tuning: each modality chooses C with smallest pooled inner-OOF Brier; all fitted preprocessing confined to respective training rows
thresholds: training-only OOF balanced-accuracy median maximizer, frozen grid 0.05 to 0.95 step 0.005; per-record decisions majority across outer repeats, ties positive
quality_threshold_fitting: each inner validation quality transformed using inner fit rows only; outer test quality transformed using outer train rows only
probability_aggregation: average once-per-repeat outer-held-out probability per mathematical record before evaluation
metric_conventions: log loss clips probabilities at 1e-6; ECE is sample-weighted absolute calibration gap in ten equal-width bins; undefined precision/F1 return zero; MCC returns zero if denominator zero

uncertainty.pairing: same sampled indices for all methods
uncertainty.interpretation: conditional on fitted cross-validation predictions and these synthetic fixtures; not retraining uncertainty or a clinical population CI

gate_validity: binary and continuous fMRI utility computed independently from held-out unimodal probabilities; AUC(weight predicting utility>0), Spearman(weight,utility); constant/degenerate associations reported unavailable
timing: wall time for the complete shared benchmark, hardware/platform/threadpool versions recorded; no method speed ranking because classifiers are shared; no native peak-memory claim
execution: single thread for BLAS/OpenMP using threadpoolctl; CPU computation, no GPU acceleration claimed
publication_policy: report all conditions and methods, including worse/equal/inconclusive; paired intervals are descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims
exclusions_from_claims: independent cohorts represented by synthetic seeds
